requirements.invariant: 021F may authorize an exact deployment binding but deployment mechanics, desired/observed state, progressive rollout and convergence remain 021S-owned; owner mismatch blocks.
Current 021U containment/freeze/quarantine commands take precedence over ordinary change progression according to policy; 021F does not declare incidents.
Incident correlation binds exact change revision and execution timeline while remaining explicitly correlation-only; causation is never inferred.
Provider-impacting changes consume current 021Y provider standing plus exit/concentration implications; restricted/prohibited/unknown standing blocks or replans.
Resource-intensive changes require a current unexpired 021H admission/capacity decision; deferred/rejected/unknown/stale standing cannot authorize execution.
Lead time, execution duration, change-associated failure, recovery time and rework remain distinct versioned observations; telemetry gaps are explicit and correlation is not causation.
Material failed/emergency changes create durable open post-change review/corrective-action linkage under 021U/021Z authority even after operational closure.
